description: Labelled volume-anomaly fixtures (implementation plan, criterion 3.3), for the default lookback (50) and threshold (z ≥ 3.5). Each case gives the 50 volumes before a candle and the candle's own volume. 'z' is worked by hand from the median and the MAD (or the mean absolute deviation when the MAD is 0).

cases.name: a spike far above a steady market
cases.label: anomaly

cases.name: a moderate spike just past the threshold
cases.label: anomaly

cases.name: an unusually quiet candle (only spikes are anomalies)
cases.label: normal

cases.name: a thin market: a trade after mostly empty candles stands out
cases.label: anomaly
cases.z: median 0 and MAD 0, so the mean absolute deviation (5 / 50 = 0.1) stands in: 2 / (1.253314 × 0.1) = 15.96

cases.name: the same thin market, an ordinary small trade
cases.label: normal

cases.name: steadily rising volume is not a spike
cases.label: normal

cases.name: identical volumes give nothing to compare with
cases.label: no basis
cases.z: MAD 0 and mean absolute deviation 0: no z-score
